scenes.title: Explanation — the 60-minute playbook
scenes.vo: 0 to 5 min: Verify. Official channels only (bookmarked X/Discord/status page, security firms). Don't click links in DMs, and don't sign anything "to protect funds". 5 to 20 min: Contain. 20 to 60 min: Stabilise. Check HFs across all positions (prices may be moving), top up from the reserve, and journal every action with timestamps. After: Review. What was the signal, what worked, and what changes in the caps and the register? First, Protocol exploit: withdraw if still possible and safe; revoke approvals to affected contracts. Next, Depeg: follow your written peg rule (for example exit below 0.99 for X hours); don't panic-sell far below it on a thin book. And finally, Wallet compromise: move remaining assets to a fresh wallet (new seed, clean device); revoke approvals; assume the old seed is burned.

scenes.vo: Question one. First thing to do in an incident? [[pause 4]] The answer: Verify through official, bookmarked channels.

scenes.q: Someone offers a link to "rescue your funds". What do you do?
scenes.a: Ignore it. It's a common scam during incidents.

scenes.q: Wallet compromised: can you keep using the seed?
scenes.a: No. Move to a fresh wallet with a new seed; the old one is burned.
